lines.5: It felt wrong, so I asked Fukahire about it.
lines.6: 「When you're beating up delinquents from another school, you're a hero. But if you beat the hell out of people from our own school, people start thinking you're a mad dog.」
lines.8: 「But back then, if I hadn't done that, Konoe would've--」
lines.9: 「Yeah, I believe you. But everybody else might not see it that way.」
lines.11: 「Nobody wants to get dragged into trouble, so I think they're keeping a little distance.」
lines.12: 「Damn... Right. This was a fight between people from the same school.」
lines.13: 「They're afraid they'll get caught up in revenge.」
lines.14: 「Exactly. And the rumors are awful. They've already reached our class. They say Leo Tsushima goes way too far when he snaps and he's scary as hell.」
lines.15: 「Hey, what is that? I did it to protect Konoe, but isn't everyone emphasizing only that part?」
lines.16: 「That's how rumors work... I learned that when I got rejected...」
lines.17: 「I tried to defend you, but girls already treat me like a germ, so I doubt it helped much.」
lines.19: --Back then, if I had not stopped them that way, I could not have protected her.
lines.20: But the people around me did not understand that.
lines.21: Instead, they distanced themselves from me.
lines.22: That was when I realized it.
lines.23: I was supposed to have done the right thing, yet I was the one standing apart.
lines.24: It was nothing like the heroes on television.
lines.25: A contradiction, you could call it.
lines.26: But the real shock was still to come.
